title: READY or Not: Reliable Enterprise Agent Deployment
reasons: 未找到 LLM / Agent 评测对象与基准主题的共同证据
missingSignals: 明确提出新的评测资料或框架
材料中提供代码或数据链接（未核验内容）
给出任务规模或覆盖范围
讨论泛化、污染、稳健性或人工核验

evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: Existing AI-agent benchmarks measure whether an agent can complete realistic professional work, whereas enterprise deployment asks a different question: whether an agent can meet a required reliability level, under acceptable human oversight, and at tolerable cost.

evidence.label: 描述评分指标或评测协议
evidence.excerpt: Given an agent, a workflow, and a class of candidate oversight policies, READY measures the reliability and operating cost of the human-AI system, selects the minimum-cost policy that satisfies a specified reliability target, and statistically qualifies it on held-out cases.

evidence.label: 报告基线或多个模型的评测
evidence.excerpt: By making those conditions explicit and statistically testable, READY provides a basis for comparing agent systems, setting oversight requirements, and making evidence-based deployment decisions.
